dex.entry: A sprout-cub that wears a four-leaf clover like a tiny lantern-leaf; in the Long Dusk the clover gathers what light remains and glows a gentle green. A Cloverkit that trusts you is said to share its luck.

art.silhouette: Small leaf-fox sprout cub; a four-leaf clover sprouts from the top of its head, large pointed leaf-ears, lime-green face and cream underbelly, big friendly dark eyes, soft leafy tufts; faint seed-sparkles drift around it. Passes the black-blob test at 32px. Brand greens (#7bdc6b) with cream (#f5f0e1) and an ink (#1a1430) outline, ~12 colours.

art.direction: The lucky third starter — cosy, plucky, and grows into a steadfast guardian who never leaves a friend in the dark.
